description: Run the Greenhouse quality gate before handing off or committing: typecheck, lint (with the plugin boundary check) and the full test suite, then the extra gates the change surface needs (HTTP security e2e, plugin assembly and core-only run, universal client checks and browser suite, desktop), a compliance scan of the changed files, a docs-sync check and a status table. Use for: run the gate / check code quality / pre-commit self check / quality gate, 跑一下门禁, 检查代码质量, 提交前自检, 质量检查. Red lines: never trim the default suite, report red as red.
